baseline: same sparse observations fitted by bounded least squares with repeated M3/M4 solves; field interpolation baseline is cubic/linear interpolation without PDE residual
target_defect: test whether sparse internal synthetic observations are sufficient for parameter inversion and continuous field reconstruction without dense labels
new_mechanism: neural fields T_theta(xi,zeta,t,p), C_theta(xi,zeta,t,p) constrained by frozen M3/M4 PDE, initial conditions, Robin boundaries, axis symmetry and Q4 mapping/Jacobian
loss: L = wd*Ldata + wp*(Lmass_PDE+Lenergy_PDE) + wb*Lboundary + wi*Linitial + wc*Lconservation; weights chosen only on validation data and reported
inputs: sparse synthetic T/C observations generated by verified PDE

inverse_parameters.identifiability_gate: scaled sensitivity matrix full rank, condition number<=1e6, profile interval not touching bounds; otherwise report only identifiable combination

synthetic_observation_design.times: 12 logarithmically/decision-spaced times including both sides of threshold; no direct threshold label
noise: T Gaussian sigma=0.2 K and C Gaussian sigma=0.005 kg/kg
T sigma=0.5 K and C sigma=0.01 kg/kg

architecture_budget: 4-6 fully-connected layers, 64 neurons/layer, tanh or sine selected on validation; <=100k trainable weights; no architecture sweep on test
dependencies: PyTorch CPU; CUDA optional but CPU result mandatory
minimum_experiment_matrix: Q3 fixed-domain reconstruction at three observation densities and three noise levels
Q4 moving-domain reconstruction at medium density for three noise levels
one-parameter inverse trials for hm and diffusivity prefactor
two-parameter trial only after identifiability gate
ablations: no PDE residual, no boundary residual, no conservation term
same unified interpolation/extrapolation scenarios and seeds
expected_evidence: recovery error versus known synthetic truth, field error at unobserved points, independent-stencil residuals and threshold-event error
retention_threshold: use the PINN rule in 统一比较合同.json
fallback: if inversion is non-identifiable or no-PDE baseline is equal/better within seed variation, retain bounded PDE least squares/interpolation and report PINN as rejected
claim_limit: synthetic recovery demonstrates numerical identifiability only; it is not validation against real herb observations
literature_transfer: P11/L06-L09 supports physics-informed heat/mass constraint categories
P12/L15 and P13/L16 support drying PINN/parameterized PINN feasibility but not guaranteed speed on this geometry
P16/L13-L17 supports Fick-law coefficient identification; only the inverse-problem pattern transfers
